plugins.name: mosaic-admin
plugins.description: Admin MCP plugin for managing Mosaic Wellness page configs — PDPs, widget pages, experiments, and brand settings via the Zeus admin-mcp server.

plugins.name: kai-dev
plugins.description: JIRA-driven development orchestrator — takes a ticket and drives it end-to-end: understanding, exploring, planning, building, reviewing, and creating PRs. Works in any repository.

plugins.name: kai
plugins.description: Mosaic Wellness internal-tooling co-pilot — wires Mixpanel, Firebase, New Relic, and the Kai orchestrator MCPs with brand-aware skills, and ships an interactive tools-init wizard that provisions credentials durably to ~/.config/kai/tokens.env. Auto-migrates from a prior mosaic-buddy install.

plugins.name: mosaic-buddy
plugins.description: [DEPRECATED — install `kai` instead] Technical co-pilot for non-engineering teams — health checks, stack review, UX audits, brainstorming, documentation, debugging, and weekly coaching.
